Class SimpleMotorSubsystem

java.lang.Object
org.wpilib.command2.SubsystemBase
xbot.common.command.BaseSubsystem
xbot.common.subsystems.simple.SimpleMotorSubsystem
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.wpilib.command2.Subsystem, org.wpilib.telemetry.TelemetryLoggable, TunablePrefixProvider
public abstract class SimpleMotorSubsystem extends BaseSubsystem
Generic subsystem that handles a single motor which can be driven in forward and reverse.
